CertConfig.description_en: The HTTPS certificate configuration for a custom domain name
CertConfig.description_zh: 自定义域名的 HTTPS 证书配置

certName.description_en: The certificate name, which is used to identify the certificate in the console
certName.description_zh: 证书名称，用于在控制台标识该证书

certificate.description_en: The certificate public key content in PEM format, including the complete certificate chain
certificate.description_zh: PEM 格式的证书公钥内容，包含完整的证书链

privateKey.description_en: The certificate private key content in PEM format. The private key is encrypted and stored on the server side, and is not returned in plaintext when queried
privateKey.description_zh: PEM 格式的证书私钥内容。服务端加密存储，查询时不返回明文
privateKey.example:
-----BEGIN RSA PRIVATE KEY-----
****
-----END RSA PRIVATE KEY-----

certConfig.description_en: The HTTPS certificate configuration used by the domain name
certConfig.description_zh: 域名使用的 HTTPS 证书配置

createdAt.description_en: The time when the domain name was created. The value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds
createdAt.description_zh: 域名的创建时间，为 Unix 时间戳，单位为毫秒

description.description_en: The description of the custom domain name
description.description_zh: 自定义域名的描述信息
description.example: 沙箱预览环境入口域名

tlsConfig.description_en: The TLS protocol configuration used by the domain name
tlsConfig.description_zh: 域名使用的 TLS 协议配置

updatedAt.description_en: The time when the domain name was last updated. The value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds
updatedAt.description_zh: 域名的最后更新时间，为 Unix 时间戳，单位为毫秒

TLSConfig.description_en: The TLS protocol configuration for a custom domain name
TLSConfig.description_zh: 自定义域名的 TLS 协议配置

cipherSuites.description_en: The list of allowed TLS cipher suites. If this parameter is not specified, the server default cipher suites are used
cipherSuites.description_zh: 允许使用的 TLS 加密套件列表。不配置时使用服务端默认套件

maxVersion.description_en: The maximum TLS protocol version allowed. Example values: TLSv1.2 and TLSv1.3. If this parameter is not specified, the server default value is used. Do not pass an empty string
maxVersion.description_zh: 允许的最高 TLS 协议版本。取值示例：TLSv1.2、TLSv1.3。不配置时使用服务端默认值，不要传入空字符串

minVersion.description_en: The minimum TLS protocol version allowed. Example values: TLSv1.2 and TLSv1.3. If this parameter is not specified, the server default value is used. Do not pass an empty string
minVersion.description_zh: 允许的最低 TLS 协议版本。取值示例：TLSv1.2、TLSv1.3。不配置时使用服务端默认值，不要传入空字符串

fields.help_zh: 证书名称，用于在控制台标识该证书
